films.title: Toys in the Attic
films.original_title: Na půdě aneb Kdo má dneska narozeniny?
films.synopsis: In a cluttered attic, a doll named Buttercup lives with a marionette, a teddy bear, a mechanical mouse and a plasticine creature. When she is kidnapped and taken to the Land of Evil, her friends set out on a dangerous rescue mission against the Head of State.
films.the_mood: Whimsical and slightly menacing stop-motion adventure: dusty attic inventiveness, handmade toys, and a fairy-tale quest that keeps a chill under the charm.
films.notes: Added for films-like-Coraline whimsical-dread group. Czech stop-motion by Jiří Barta.
